<!-- What you want, as you'd type it to /create. The queue first asks what
     could make it lighter (reply "yes" to take every recommendation, or
     answer by number), then plans it (an estimate in % of the week, the
     files to touch, what it won't do); over 3 % it keeps the
     most impactful slice and opens the rest as one backlog issue. Then the
     mockup (only if there is something to see): reply "approve", "no" (to
     the backlog) or what to change. Then the build: "approve" merges it. -->
